Eve / Priya — initial draft attached (I will attach the playbook and sample JSON logs in the outbound). Notes on each ask from Rajiv:

1) Isolation model: we should emphasize three controls — tenant networking (vhost + VLAN separation), storage encryption at rest per tenant with separate tenant keys, and host labeling that prevents cross-tenant KV cache sharing. Add a diagram that shows physical host -> dedicated pool -> tenant mount namespace.

2) Wipe workflow: propose the following timeline in the playbook:
   - request received (T+0) -> create wipe ticket and lock reads (T+1m)
   - snapshot tombstone (T+5m) -> mark snapshot deleted from retention index (metadata-only)
   - purge job across replicas (T+30m to T+6h depending on size)
   - final scrub on media (T+24h) -> confirmation event emitted + artifact id (PURGE-JOB-xxxx)

We already have sample PURGE-JOB ids and console traces; I will remove tenant GUIDs and replace with BRIGHT-XXXXX placeholders.

3) Replayability: after a wipe the tombstoned snapshots are removed from the retention catalog; if an emergency restore is required we surface the event in the audit logs and require legal approval + an airgap admin key (we should document the legal sign-off flow).

4) Acceptance checklist: Laura, suggested legal wording for "signed acceptance"? I added a placeholder but want your sign-off before sending.

Attaching: sanitization-playbook-v1.md (draft), sample-log-excerpts.txt (sanitized).

-Aditya

Rajiv — attaching the sanitized dossier and ops checklist for BrightBank's audit. Key legal acceptance points are embedded in section 4 of the dossier; short summary below: 

- Evidence scope: the artifacts we provide (console trace links, purge job ids, and log excerpts) are sufficient for operational verification of the wipe chain. They are not full Forensic images; for forensic e-discovery we will coordinate a separate procedure.
- Time-to-wipe SLA: we document typical timelines and express them as ranges (dependent on data size). If you require firm contractual SLAs for purge completion, that should be added to the Dedicated contract (we can provide tiered SLA language).
- Restore prevention: we will annotate the audit artifact with the retention index mutation and admin keys required for any restore; BrightBank will receive a signed attestation that no automatic restore path exists once the purge job completes.

Attached: site-fence-dossier.pdf, sanitization-playbook-v1.md (ops checklist), sample-log-excerpts.txt (sanitized).
